description.value: Kiku Sushi is a Japanese restaurant at Metrotown in Burnaby, one of two Lower Mainland locations, serving sushi, rolls, grilled entrees, noodles, and kitchen appetizers. The restaurant describes a large dining hall with a cozy interior and a broad menu designed to suit varied tastes. A touring cyclist riding the Kingsway corridor would find a full sit-down meal option here with online ordering also available.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: rack at 33m; rack (7 spaces, covered) at 70m. Total: 7 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is the Metrotown location of a two-location sushi chain, with address 4986 Kingsway, Burnaby, BC V5H 2E2 and phone 604-434-6020 — both matching OSM. Online ordering is prominently featured on the website ('Order Online', 'Order online from 2 locations'), confirming takeout. No mention of bike parking, washrooms, water refill, or any cycling-specific amenities anywhere on the site; OSM tags also carry no relevant amenity data for these.
concerns: OSM community field says 'Vancouver' but the website clearly identifies this location as Burnaby (4986 Kingsway, Burnaby, BC V5H 2E2); address updated to Burnaby per website.
This is a two-location chain; the second location (1368 W Pender St, Vancouver) may or may not have a separate OSM record — check for duplicates.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Kiku Sushi is a legitimate operating restaurant suitable for a meal stop, but no evidence of bike parking or visibility could be found, which is a required criterion for Food & Drink listings. A site visit or direct contact is needed to confirm bike parking before inclusion.
